snippet.title: Paris Jackson on Being “Daddy’s Little Princess”
snippet.description:
In her Call Her Daddy interview, Paris Jackson opened up about her relationship with her dad, Michael Jackson, and described him simply as a “really funny guy.”

When asked if they shared the same sense of humor, Paris explained that she thinks a lot of it came from the people around them and from growing up with her siblings. It’s a small, relatable glimpse into the family dynamic behind the superstar everyone knew.

Paris was also asked if she considered herself “Daddy’s little princess.” She explained that Michael tried to treat all of his children equally, but at the same time, she acknowledged that she was still his little girl. 🤍

There’s something so sweet and relatable about hearing Paris describe their relationship—not just as Michael Jackson and his daughter, but as a dad and his daughter who shared jokes, personalities, and that special bond that can exist between fathers and daughters. Sometimes, no matter how hard a parent tries to treat everyone exactly the same, there are simply different relationships between each child and their parent. 🤍




#parisjackson #michaeljackson

snippet.title: Paris Jackson is continuing to speak out against those running her dad Michael Jackson’s estate
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson is continuing to speak out against those running her dad Michael Jackson’s estate amid an ongoing legal battle over the late star’s finances.

Paris, 28, filed a new legal document on Monday, April 6 accusing executors John Branca and John McClain of using their latest status report to “mock and belittle” her, according to court documents obtained by PEOPLE.
